items.title: Ray Vega interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 20, 2023

ctx.x: How do you apply it? Well codifying, how do you explain it all, and how do you put it into words? The problem here I would say is that many of the academics that are coming out here right now understand the math of it but they’ve never put a set list together in Europe trying to figure out who — well the heck with Europe, I’ve done that enough times, I’m talking about they haven’t even done a local gig looking into the audience and going okay we’ve got to play this, let’s try this, let’s read the audience.…

Stan Getz played by ear. Chet Baker played by ear. Okay? Chet Baker played by ear. I want to say Nat Adderley played by ear. CT — Clark Terry — played by ear. He worked all of his stuff out. Maynard Ferguson, now people might go naa, but Maynard Ferg — baloney. Listen to the early recordings of Maynard ‘cause Maynard could play some bebop. Okay? Maynard, he had F’s above double high C louder than anybody in the business but, and he told this to Art Falbush who teaches at Oneonta, SUNY Oneonta, because Art’s…
